description: This file defines a React component for the login page of a web application. It provides authentication functionalities such as sign-in, sign-up, password reset, password recovery, and magic link (OTP) sign-in using Supabase. The component manages UI state, handles user interactions, and interacts with the Supabase authentication API.

methods.name: friendlyError
methods.description: Converts technical error messages from Supabase into user-friendly messages.

methods.name: handleSignup
methods.description: Handles user sign-up process using email and password.

methods.name: handleSignin
methods.description: Handles user sign-in process using email and password.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Sends a password reset email to the user.

methods.name: handleUpdatePassword
methods.description: Updates the user's password during password recovery.

methods.name: handleOtp
methods.description: Sends a magic link (OTP) to the user's email for authentication.

methods.name: renderTabs
methods.description: Renders the tab controls for switching between sign-in, sign-up, OTP, and recovery modes.
